name: dominodatalab
description: Domino Data Lab skills for Workspaces, Jobs, Compute Environments, Datasets, Projects, Apps, model endpoints and monitoring, MLflow experiment tracking, Flows, Spark/Ray/Dask/MPI clusters, LLM access, and the Domino APIs and SDKs, for Domino 6.1

domino_host.title: Domino URL
domino_host.description: Only for use outside a Domino Workspace: the address you open Domino at in your browser, for example https://domino.example.com. Leave empty inside a Workspace.

domino_token.title: Domino service account token
domino_token.description: Only for use outside a Domino Workspace: a service account token from your Domino administrator. Kept in your system's secure credential store. To use a user API key instead, leave this empty and set DOMINO_API_KEY in the env file. Leave empty inside a Workspace.
